title: UNIQON Billing Pro • Android Build 293 (100% Silent Google Drive Auto-Backup & License Recovery)
highlights: 100% Silent Google Drive Auto-Backup: Invoices and data changes are automatically backed up to Google Drive in the background with zero pop-up interruptions.
Auto-Sync on Bill and Exit: Instant silent backup triggers on invoice creation, app minimize, and app exit.
Automatic License & Company Logo Recovery: Pro activation and branding persist across all backup and restore cycles.
fixes: Integrated Google Cloud OAuth 2.0 Client credentials with Android Credential Manager.
Added debounced background auto-backup worker on billing and system back exit.
Preserved offline SQLite data and safety snapshots.
